summary: Provision interim cloud workspace + temporary encrypted loaner for APAC contractor with deferred device shipment
description: New contract start for a senior infra contractor (APAC remote) where the corporate laptop will be delayed by customs/shipping until month+2. HR requests a policy-aligned interim setup: temporary loaner device shipped locally, a staged SSO role with reduced privileges for first two weeks, and a provisional cloud workspace (redwood-dev project) using a scoped service account. Security needs clarification on KMS key handover and disk-encryption expectations for loaners. IT needs instructions for inventory tagging and eventual asset handback process.
impact: Contractor onboarding start date 2026-03-15; without interim access they'd be unable to join sprint planning and critical infra ramp-up. HR requests solution to allow start while permanent laptop remains in transit.
background: HR submitted offer acceptance and expected start date 2026-03-15. Procurement indicates corporate MacBook Pro order is placed but international shipping and customs clearance estimate 4-6 weeks. Candidate located in APAC region where we maintain a small pool of loaner hardware through partner vendor. Security policy (device-encryption and KMS custody) needs interpretation for loaners vs. corporate-assigned devices.
requested_action: 1) Approve staging a loaner with company MDM and full-disk encryption acceptable under current policy, or provide alternative (VDI only). 2) Create a 'provisional' SSO role with least-privilege access to required infra repos and the redwood-dev GCP project for 14 days. 3) Provision a scoped service account for CI tasks with short TTL credentials and audit logging enabled. 4) Document handback/rotation steps for when permanent device is received.
constraints: Loaner inventory limited to non-Mac models; vendor can deliver next-business-day in region but device must be encrypted and enrolled in MDM prior to handoff. KMS keys for loaner disk encryption: cannot reuse customer-specific HSM keys; need guidance from Security on whether to allow temporary locally-provisioned keys or require vault-wrapped keys.
comments: 2026-03-10 Priya Nair: Raised by HR (N. Gomez). Candidate start 2026-03-15 — requesting interim access while corporate laptop en route. Asked for a 14-day provisional role and loaner policy clarification.
2026-03-10 Evan Morales: Acknowledged. Will check loaner inventory and MDM enrollment ETA. Looping Security for KMS/disk encryption guidance. Assigned to infra-ops rotation.

2026-03-11 Sasha Rivera (Security): Need decision on whether loaner keys can be locally generated and wrapped by Redwood KMS or require HSM-only keys. Recommend KMS-wrapped keys with device UID in metadata. Also: loaner must have disk encryption enforced and disk rekey/erase on return.
2026-03-11 Priya Nair: HR confirmed candidate can accept VDI-only if hardware unavailable, but prefers local machine to join low-latency calls and hands-on infra work.

2026-03-12 Evan Morales: Inventory shows one eligible loaner in regional partner pool. Partner can ship next day once we approve encryption approach. Preparing a secure checklist for handover and asset-tagging.

2026-03-12 Sasha Rivera (Security): Draft policy exception: allow KMS-wrapped locally-generated disk keys with expiration set to 21 days and rotation on permanent device enrollment. Exception to be timeboxed and logged. Security requests sign-off from Head of Infosec.
2026-03-12 Priya Nair: Filed for Infosec sign-off and notified HR to delay candidate start to remote onboarding call if necessary.
investigation_notes: Checked partner vendor SLA (next-business-day) and MDM enrollment automation. Confirmed loaner models support company MDM and FileVault/BitLocker. Verified that we can create a scoped service account and grant short-lived credentials via OIDC token exchange. Security needs to approve KMS exception before shipping.
resolution: Pending - security exception drafted and awaiting Head of Infosec sign-off (expected 2026-03-13). If approved, Evan to trigger loaner shipment and IT to provision provisional SSO role and scoped service account with 14-day TTL. Post-resolution steps: asset-return checklist, KMS rotation runbook, and add case to onboarding FAQ.
next_steps: 1) Security sign-off (target 2026-03-13). 2) If approved, issue MDM enrollment link and schedule remote handoff with IT. 3) Create provisional role and log in Access Review for 14-day expiry. 4) Track asset return and rotate keys upon permanent device enrollment.
